none: PAS NLM-B54B06: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, probably Trier mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory holding shield advancing left on prow. In exergue: possibly TRP. Diameter: 14.4mm, Weight: 1.02gms, die axis: 6
